title: feat(console): server-side pagination + search pushdown on the approvals inbox
body:
Companion to objectstack-ai/framework (listRequests q/limit/offset + countRequests). Closes the inbox half of framework#1745.

- **Submitted/All tabs**: 50-row server windows, "加载更多" appender, "已加载 X / 共 Y 条" footer. Verified live: 56 rows → first page 50 + button → 56/56 and the button disappears.
- **Server search**: debounced (350ms) `q` pushdown — record titles match via the payload snapshot, so hits come from the entire dataset, not the loaded page (verified: a title on an unloaded page matched).
- **Status filter** pushes down with the page query; My Pending keeps instant client-side matching (bounded personal queue).
- 3 new `approvalsInbox.*` keys × 10 locales (parity green on this branch).

Tests: i18n 100/100 ✅ · tsc clean ✅ · API-level paging verified (no page overlap, accurate totals, status pushdown).
